evidence.quote: Near-term risks to the economic outlook have diminished.
Job gains were strong in June following weak growth in May.
Inflation has continued to run below the Committee's 2 percent longer-run objective
The Committee expects that economic conditions will evolve in a manner that will warrant only gradual increases in the federal funds rate
the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 1/4 to 1/2 percent.
Voting against the action was Esther L. George, who preferred at this meeting to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/2 to 3/4 percent.

parsed.rationale: The statement holds rates steady, keeps reinvestment going, and notes below-target inflation, but it also describes a stronger labor market and diminished near-term risks. Together with a hawkish dissent, that gives a slight hawkish tilt within a mostly neutral statement that keeps its gradual guidance.
